facts.fact: 她整夜翻来覆去，只断断续续睡了几个小时。
facts.anchor: Kiamling managed only a few restless hours’ sleep, tossing and turning.

facts.fact: Archie 逃走前脸上那副惊恐，不是她以为今晚会有的收场。
facts.anchor: The look of horror on Archie’s face before he had fled was not how she had expected her evening to end.

facts.fact: Ng Choy 家的老仆只看了一眼她的衣着，就不肯放她进门。
facts.anchor: The servant who answered the door took one look at her attire and refused to let her in.

facts.fact: 老仆低声念了一句“佛祖保佑”。
facts.anchor: “Buddha preserve us,” the old Chinese servant mumbled under his breath

facts.fact: 门再开时，站在那儿的换成了 Ng Choy 本人。
facts.anchor: Barrister Ng Choy stood there in place of the servant.

facts.fact: 书房一整面墙都是书，英文布面精装，书名诸如《法律原理》。
facts.anchor: One entire wall was bookcases, austere cloth-bound English books with names like The Principles of Law.

facts.fact: 他替她滤茶，又加了一小壶奶和两块方糖。
facts.anchor: He poured her a cup through the strainer, topping it with creamy milk from a small jug and two lumps of sugar.

facts.fact: 她嫌太甜，把嘴里的茶吐回杯中。
facts.anchor: She spat the mouthful of tea back into her cup, appalled at the sweetness.

facts.fact: 他的语调表明他来自马六甲，而不是广州。
facts.anchor: his inflection marking him out as being from Malacca rather than Canton.

facts.fact: 他说自己不记得睡了几周，可身体确实想念茶。
facts.anchor: “I might not remember being asleep for weeks, but my body certainly missed tea.”

facts.fact: 他自称是历史上第一个华人律师。
facts.anchor: “My dear child, I am the first Chinese barrister in history.

facts.fact: 他说 Bowring 总督眼下要办教育、办卫生，想当这块殖民地的慈祥祖父。
facts.anchor: Governor Bowring wants to support education and health at the moment, to be the colony’s benevolent grandfather.

facts.fact: 她明白他这份感激只值一杯喝不下去的茶和让她进门的体面。
facts.anchor: A cup of undrinkable tea and the honour of being allowed into his house.

facts.fact: 她回茶楼，从 Keilin 手里拿过洗碗桶。
facts.anchor: She took the washing-up bucket from Keilin’s startled hands

facts.fact: 她托 Keilin 约妹妹见面，说要道歉。
facts.anchor: “Can you tell Jingling I want to meet up? I want to say… sorry.”

facts.fact: Soon 先生说她家的保佑和防护失灵，至少要退款。
facts.anchor: “Your blessings and protections malfunctioned; the least you can do is offer a refund.

facts.fact: 救 Ng Choy 挣来的钱就这样全没了。
facts.anchor: There went all the money she had earned from rescuing Barrister Ng.

facts.fact: 就算十八层地狱挡路，她也要去护着妹妹。
facts.anchor: The eighteen levels of hell would not stop her from protecting her sister.

facts.fact: 她叫 Keilin 立刻跑去总督府找英国人 Archie Redferne。
facts.anchor: “Go, run to Government House. Get the Englishman, Archie Redferne. Now!”

facts.fact: 粉色花苞绽开成亮眼的五瓣兰花。
facts.anchor: Pink buds burst open into bright five-petalled orchids.
